episodes.name: The Fresh Prince Project
episodes.overview: Aunt Vivian tries to mediate between her husband Philip and the newly arrived Will.

episodes.name: Bang the Drum, Ashley
episodes.overview: Will persuades Ashley to pawn her violin for a drum set.

episodes.name: Clubba Hubba
episodes.overview: Will wants to go out with a beautiful girl he meets at the country club, but first he must figure out how to impress her extremely snobbish and very protective father so he seeks tips from cousin Carlton on becoming preppie.

episodes.name: Not with My Pig, You Don't
episodes.overview: Will tries to smooth things between Philip and his very rural parents when they visit to see him receive an award.

episodes.name: Homeboy, Sweet Homeboy
episodes.overview: Will gets a visit from an old pal named Ice Tray, who, to Vivian and Philip's dismay, warms up to Hilary.

episodes.name: Mistaken Identity
episodes.overview: Jailed, Will and Carlton stage a media stunt.

episodes.name: Def Poet's Society
episodes.overview: Will joins his prep school's poetry club.

episodes.name: Someday Your Prince Will Be in Effect (1)
episodes.overview: Carlton and Will, babe magnets. Who will be first to get a date for Hilary's Halloween party?

episodes.name: Someday Your Prince Will Be in Effect (2)
episodes.overview: Carlton and Will, babe magnets. Who will be first to get a date for Hilary's Halloween party?

episodes.name: Kiss My Butler
episodes.overview: Happy birthday Geoffrey! For a gift, Will tries matchmaking, then falls for Geoffrey's date himself.

episodes.name: Courting Disaster
episodes.overview: Carlton feels overshadowed by Will, who's become a basketball star at school.

episodes.name: Talking Turkey
episodes.overview: A holiday visit from Will's taskmaster mother puts the kibosh on conspicuous consumption and puts the kids to work preparing Thanksgiving dinner.

episodes.name: Knowledge is Power
episodes.overview: Hilary becomes Will's personal maid when he threatens to disclose she's dropped out of UCLA.

episodes.name: Day Damn One
episodes.overview: Will tells Ashley's slumber party guests a scary tale about his first day at Bel-Air Academy.

episodes.name: Deck the Halls
episodes.overview: Will inimitably dresses the mansion for the holidays, to the dismay of the neighbors, including heavyweight boxing champion Evander Holyfield.

episodes.name: The Lucky Charm
episodes.overview: Philip may lose a superstitious client whom he advises not to make decisions based on Will's spontaneous remarks.

episodes.name: The Ethnic Tip
episodes.overview: Will proposes a black history class be instituted at Bel-Air Academy, and gets a surprise when Aunt Viv arrives to teach it.

episodes.name: The Young and the Restless
episodes.overview: Will sneaks Philip's elderly mother out of the house for a night on the town.

episodes.name: It Had to Be You
episodes.overview: Will has girl problems after a date with Jazz's domineering sister, who's ready to pick out a china pattern before the night is over.

episodes.name: Nice Lady
episodes.overview: Fresh Prince Will is on his best behavior for visiting royalty - the seemingly demure Lady Penelope, who Will hopes to persuade to let herself have a good time at a party.

episodes.name: Love at First Fight
episodes.overview: Jasmine Guy plays a scholarship student whose introduction to Will opens up a different world of fun and games - and romance - to divert her from her studies.

episodes.name: Banks Shot
episodes.overview: Will crawls to Philip for help after sneaking out on the town and getting hustled by sleazy pool sharks.

episodes.name: 72 Hours
episodes.overview: Will challenges Carlton to spend time in a tough neighborhood, trying to survive by masquerading as a financial consultant.

episodes.name: Just Infatuation
episodes.overview: R&B singer Tevin Campbell plays teen idol Little T, who surprises Ashley on her birthday with a special song and an invitation for a date.

episodes.name: Working It Out
episodes.overview: Rap's Queen Latifah plays Hilary's new actress boss, who wants Will as her boy toy - or Hilary's glamorous job is over.
